description: Complete a query tuning session by either applying the changes to the main branch or discarding them.

applyChanges.description: Whether to apply the tuning session's changes to the original branch (true) or discard them (false); the temporary branch is deleted either way.

projectId.description: ID of the Neon project the tuning session was prepared for; must match the session's project.

tuningId.description: ID of the query tuning session returned by prepare_query_tuning.

name: complete_query_tuning
